objective: Test one narrow consequence of the documented primary-dealer Treasury-auction constraint: whether nominal 10-year Treasury auctions are associated with a repeatable local 10-year curve cheapening by the auction-day close. This is a mechanism/economic screen, not yet a profitability claim.

sample.event_rule: All nominal U.S. Treasury Note auctions whose original security term is 10-Year, including reopenings; exclude TIPS and any event lacking prior-business-day, auction-day, or next-business-day official 5Y/10Y/30Y CMT observations.

market_proxy.note: Official CMTs are based on indicative bid-side market quotations at or near 3:30 PM ET; this screen therefore measures end-of-day curve movement, not the exact 1 PM when-issued auction tail.

transform.positive_primary_interpretation: 10-year sector cheapened relative to 5Y/30Y wings into the auction-day close
transform.positive_secondary_interpretation: auction-day cheapening reversed by the next business-day close

primary_endpoint.test: one-sample one-sided t-test H0 mean<=0 versus H1 mean>0
primary_endpoint.pass_rule: PASS_SCREEN only if one-sided p<0.05 AND sample mean>=0.25 bps
primary_endpoint.fail_rule: Otherwise FAIL_SCREEN for this frozen expression; do not retune this expression.

secondary_endpoints.reversal: Report mean secondary_reversal_metric_bps and one-sided p-value, descriptive only and not permitted to rescue a failed primary endpoint.
secondary_endpoints.sign_robustness: Report fraction of events with primary_event_metric_bps>0 and exact/binomial sign-test p-value, descriptive only.
secondary_endpoints.methodology_split: Report primary mean separately for 2010-2021-12-05 and 2021-12-06 through 2025 because Treasury changed yield-curve methodology; this is robustness only and cannot redefine the primary decision.

multiplicity.method: Only the primary endpoint controls PASS/FAIL; all other endpoints are descriptive and cannot rescue failure.

claim_boundary.pass_means: Evidence of a repeatable daily local-curve cheapening associated with pre-announced 10-year auctions, warranting a separately frozen tradable P&L test.
claim_boundary.pass_does_not_mean: Dealer inventory causality proven, auction-tail alpha proven, or net profitability proven.
claim_boundary.fail_means: This daily frozen expression is falsified and will not be retuned; move to the next admissible candidate or a materially new generation with explicit new rationale.

cost_capacity: NOT_APPLIED_TO_MECHANISM_SCREEN. Any subsequent tradable P&L test must freeze executable instrument, fees, spread, slippage, financing, capacity and sizing before viewing its returns.
owner_authorization: Economic outcome access is authorized only after this protocol file is committed. Real capital and live trading are not required for this screen.
